title: Compound_C Horse IM, three doses about 24 h apart
experimental_unit: Serial individual Horse; one concentration column per animal, 6 profiles in this table.

metadata.condition: single laboratory; healthy adult animals; intramuscular product is an aqueous suspension of a salt of the compound

notes: Actual sampling times, hours after the first intramuscular dose. Three intramuscular doses per animal, about 24 h apart; each concentration column carries its animal (subject_id) and every dose with its actual time (dose_events). The table dose_mg_kg is the median first dose. Concentrations after the second and third dose include drug from the earlier doses. All records are quantified; none is flagged.

title: Compound_C Horse IV, single dose
experimental_unit: Serial individual Horse; one concentration column per animal, 6 profiles in this table.

metadata.condition: single laboratory; healthy adult animals; same animals as the IM table

notes: Actual sampling times, hours after the start of the intravenous injection. Short injection, duration recorded per animal; each concentration column carries its animal (subject_id), its own dose (dose_mg_kg) and its own injection duration (infusion_h). The same six animals as the IM table, on a separate occasion. All records are quantified; none is flagged.
